name: Claude Flow
description:
Structured project cognition + autonomous execution framework for Claude Code. Includes 9 skills (TDD enforcement, 8-layer
  deep-task engine, persistent DAG scheduler, adversarial code review, bug diagnosis, feature planning, brainstorming), 3 specialized
   agents (feature-builder, code-reviewer, test-writer), and 5 hooks (file protection, bash validation, lint feedback, session state
  persistence, context reinjection). Helps Claude Code work on complex, multi-step engineering tasks with structure, verification,
  and continuity.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills**, **3 agents** and **7 commands**.

- **Skills** (4): `_template` ({framework/module} usage guide: {keyword-1}, {keyword-2}, {keyword-3}), `brainstorming`, `tdd` (TDD development: test-driven development, RED-GREEN-REFACTOR, unit tests, integration tests), `verification` (Pre-completion verification: code submission checks, feature completion validation, bug fix confirmation, constitution compliance audit)
- **Agents** (3): `code-reviewer` (Adversarial code review agent), `feature-builder` (General-purpose feature implementation agent), `test-writer` (Adversarial test writer)
- **Commands** (7): `autosolve` (Launch persistent shell scheduler with kanban board), `bug-fix` (Diagnose and fix bugs, solidify learnings into Rules/Skills/Memory), `deep-task` (Autonomous 8-layer deep execution engine for complex tasks), `feature-plan-creator` (Analyze requirements and generate a technical plan), `init-project` (Analyze the codebase and auto-generate all claude-flow configuration files), `install-codex` (Install OpenAI codex-plugin-cc to use Codex (code review / task delegation) inside Claude Code), `upgrade` (Upgrade claude-flow templates to the latest version)

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-flow@claude-community` from `CookiRui/claude-flow`.
